notes.title: Update 1.7.4
notes.notes: [p]Update 1.8 and Season 5 are coming soon. And before the new season, we still need to make some minor balance adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][p][/p][h3]Sledgehammer[/h3][list][*][p]EXP required for rank-up: 1000 → 1300[/p][/*][*][p]\[Electromagnetic Shot] Price 300 → 400[/p][/*][*][p]If any player in a match already has a Sledgehammer, the \[Extended Range Sledgehammer] variant will not appear in reinforcements cards.[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: After enhancing the anti-chaff capabilities of units such as Arclight and Mustang, we anticipated that Sledgehammer, as one of the few medium frontline units capable of simultaneously countering anti-chaff units like Arclight and Mustang as well as high-damage units like Melting Point, would become more popular in the new meta. Therefore, we buffed Raiden in the previous patch as a counter to Sledgehammer. However, buffing Raiden appears not to be enough, as statistical data show there are still too many Sledgehammers in the current meta, especially in the 1600 - 1900 MMR range. This 1.7.4 Update aims to slightly nerf Sledgehammer's late-game capabilities while maintaining its identity as a medium frontline unit, which will make strategies centered around Sledgehammer rely more on other units for coordination.[/p][p][/p][h3]Initial Unit[/h3][list][*][p]\[Hound & Steel Ball Pack] Player HP modifier +100 → +200[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Future Tests[/h2][p]Currently, the content of Update 1.8 and Season 5 is undergoing a small-scale test on the Closed Beta Server, and Update 1.8 will be our last major update that primarily relies on closed testing. We are in the process of setting up a full-fledged Public Test Server, and starting from Update 1.9, all major updates will undergo public testing on the Public Test Server before their official release.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.7.3.1
notes.notes: [p]Fixed multiple new issues caused by the new math library.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.7.3
notes.notes: [p]After collecting feedback, we found that, compared with getting new units and new systems at a faster pace, most players value better balance quality and QoL features more. Therefore, in the next few months, we will avoid making disruptive changes and focus on making small adjustments to balance, adding new Tech to existing units, and adding small QoL improvement features.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][h3]Crawler[/h3][list][*][p]\[Loose Formation] Unit spacing 3.7m → 3.4m[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: Currently, the number of Crawlers used in later rounds is still too high, so we have further nerfed \[Loose Formation], which will enable units such as Arclight and Hound to be more effective against Crawlers in the late game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tarantula[/h3][list][*][p]Attack 534 → 496 (-7%)[/p][/*][*][p]\[High-Explosive Ammo] ATK Modifier -40% → -45%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: This adjustment will reduce the threat of the Tarantula to medium units while maintaining its suppression against light units.[/p][p][/p][h3]Arclight[/h3][list][*][p]HP 4498 → 4813 (+7%)[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: After last week's buff, the usage rate of Arclight has increased, but it still hasn't reached the average level of 100 supply units. After this HP buff, Arclight's survivability will be further increased.[/p][p][/p][h3]Phantom Ray[/h3][list][*][p]HP 3159 → 3412 (+8%)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Stealth Cloak] Time to enter cloaked state 1s → 2.5s, ATK modifier +40% → +20%, HP modifier 0 → +20%[/p][/*][*][p]\[Armor Enhancement] Price 300 → 250[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: In the past, the cloak mechanic made players in the mid and low MMR range feels helpless when facing a large number of Cloaked Rays. As a result, we had to keep the Phantom Ray's HP at a low level, which in turn led to a very low usage rate of the Phantom Ray. After this adjustment, the Phantom Ray's \[Stealth Cloak] will be easier to counter, but its ability to withstand damage will also be better.[/p][p][/p][h3]Mustang[/h3][list][*][p]\[High Explosive Ammo] Price 150 → 50, ATK modifier -30% → -35%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: This adjustment will make it easier for players to transform the Mustang into a specialized anti-light unit.[/p][p][/p][h3]Raiden[/h3][list][*][p]HP 17476 → 18349 (+5%)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fork] Range modifier -15 → -10[/p][/*][*][p]\[Chain] Price 300 → 250[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The usage rate of Raiden among giant units remains low. This adjustment aims to make Raiden more effective against medium-sized units such as Sledgehammer and Phantom Ray.[/p][p][/p][h3]Sledgehammer[/h3][list][*][p]\[Armor Enhancement] 300 → 250[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sabertooth[/h3][list][*][p]EXP required to rank-up 1000 → 1300[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The adjusted rank-up speed of Sabertooth will be similar to that of Void Eye and Marksman.[/p][p][/p][h3]Starting Units Pack[/h3][list][*][p]\[Tarantula & Void Eye Pack] Player HP modifier +100 → 0[/p][/*][*][p]\[Arclight & Steel Ball Pack] Player HP modifier +100 → +200[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fang & Sabertooth Pack] Player HP modifier +400 → +200[/p][/*][*][p]\[Crawler & Steel Ball Pack] Player HP modifier 0 → +100[/p][/*][*][p]\[Hound & Steel Ball Pack] Player HP modifier 0 → +100[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Math Library Improvement[/h2][p]Improvements have been made to the math library used by the combat engine, reducing performance issues caused by different CPU architectures.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the turret would continue to attack units that were converted by friendly hackers while the turret was reloading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Void Eye's \[Electromagnetic Armor] would activate before the flanking teleportation was completed[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.7.2
notes.notes: [p]The second balance patch for version 1.7 is here! As we mentioned in previous balance patches, in the coming weeks, we will continue to make frequent and fast balance adjustments based on the collected data and feedback. In addition to this balance adjustment, we have also stated some of our thoughts on future updates at the end of this post. We welcome you to leave your opinions and suggestions in the comments section of this post, Reddit, Discord, or the Steam Discussion Forum![/p][p][/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][p][/p][h3]Building Layout[/h3][p]Buildings now grant EXP when destroyed.[/p][list][*][p]Defense Wall: 6 EXP per segment[/p][/*][*][p]Rapid-fire Cannon: 60 EXP[/p][/*][*][p]Anti-Armor Cannon: 60 EXP[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: In the previous version, buildings did not grant any EXP when destroyed, which made attacking buildings not very rewarding. After today's change, units that destroy buildings will receive a small amount of EXP. We hope this will make \[destroying enemy buildings] and \[avoiding enemy buildings] both have their respective advantages. In the future, we will continue to adjust building mechanics based on collected data and feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crawler[/h3][list][*][p]HP 277 → 263 (-5%)[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: Among units that cost 100 supplies, Crawlers have the highest pick rate. The adjusted Crawlers will be more easily killed by units such as Fangs. Changes to basic units like Crawlers will have a relatively large impact on the meta, and we are likely to further adjust Crawlers based on feedback and data.[/p][p][/p][h3]Hound[/h3][list][*][p]\[Incendiary Bomb] Price 300 → 250[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The usage rate of the Hound's \[Incendiary Bomb] in the previous version was extremely low. We hope that the \[Incendiary Bomb], with a slight price reduction this time, will become a more viable option against light chaffs.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tarantula[/h3][list][*][p]HP 13683 → 13273 (-3%)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Armor Enhancement] HP modifier +40% → +50%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: As one of the two most effective chaff-clearing units in the previous patch(the other being Vulcan), Tarantula has a high usage rate. We hope to slightly nerf Tarantula's early-game survivability while slightly strengthening its late-game tankiness without changing its effectiveness against chaff. At the same time, we have also buffed Tarantula's competitors, such as Arclight. In the future, we will continue to monitor Tarantula's situation and are likely to further adjust it based on statistical data.[/p][p][/p][h3]Vulcan[/h3][list][*][p]ATK 90 → 88 (-2%)[/p][/*][*][p]HP 35332 → 33566 (-5%)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Ignite] 200 → 250[/p][/*][*][p]\[Scorching Fire] 100% → 85%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: Vulcan, as one of the two most chaff-clearing units in the previous patch (the other being Tarantula), had a high usage rate. And Vulcan was also too strong against medium units. The goal of this adjustment is to lower its effectiveness against medium and heavy units while maintaining its suppression of light units. And we have also buffed Vulcan's competitors, such as Arclight.[/p][p][/p][h3]Arclight[/h3][list][*][p]Range 93 → 95[/p][/*][*][p]HP 4204 → 4498（+7%）[/p][/*][*][p]\[Electromagnetic Shot] 300 → 400[/p][/*][*][p]\[Elite Marksman] ATK modifier per rank +22% → +17%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The usage rate of Arclight among units that cost 100 supplies is relatively low. In the past, to prevent Arclight from being too effective against medium and heavy units, we have made multiple nerfs to it. This time, we have significantly buffed Arclight, hoping that it will be more effective against light units, while slightly nerfing its ability to fight against medium and heavy units. In the future, we may further adjust Arclight based on collected data and feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]Stormcaller[/h3][list][*][p]Unlock cost 0 → 50[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: After this change, Stormcaller, like other non-initial units such as Rhino, Phoenix, and Wasp, now also costs 50 supplies to unlock. We will closely monitor the strength of the Stormcaller after this change and may slightly buff it in the future.[/p][p][/p][h3]Steel Ball[/h3][list][*][p]\[Armor Enhancement] Price 350 → 300[/p][/*][*][p]\[Mechanical Division] Price 350 → 300[/p][/*][*][p]\[Energy Absorption] Price 250 → 200[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: Steel Balls have a relatively low usage rate among units that cost 200 supplies. We hope to encourage more use of Steel Ball by reducing its technology price.[/p][p][/p][h3]Void Eye[/h3][list][*][p]HP 1371 → 1509 (+10%)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Energy Shield] price 300 → 250[/p][/*][*][p]\[Aerial Mode] price 250 → 200[/p][/*][*][p]\[Charged Shot] price 200 → 150[/p][/*][*][p]\[Suppressive Shots] price 150 → 100[/p][/*][*][p]\[Energy Absorption] price 0 → 50[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: Very surprisingly, the usage rate of the Void Eye in the mid-to-late rounds ranks last among all 31 units, only relying on the 0-cost \[Energy Absorption] to maintain a decent usage rate in the early rounds. Therefore, we have decided to give multiple buffs to the Void Eye and slightly increase the cost of \[Energy Absorption].[/p][p][/p][h3]Wasp[/h3][list][*][p]\[Elite Marksman] price 300 → 400[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's note: Wasp's \[Elite Marksman] is too cheap compared to most other units' \[Elite Marksmen] tech, so it needs a nerf.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fortress[/h3][list][*][p]ATK 6213 → 6524 (+5%)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sandworm[/h3][list][*][p]ATK 8906 → 9352 (+5%)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Raiden[/h3][list][*][p]ATK 5304 → 5570 (+5%)[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The usage rates of giant units such as Fortress, Sandworm, and Raiden remain relatively low, and we hope to make minor enhancements to them.[/p][p][/p][h3]Mountain[/h3][list][*][p]【Saturation Bombardment】 Price 400 → 500, Attack Interval 100% → 120%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: \[Saturation Bombardment] was too powerful after buffs in the previous patches, so it needs a nerf.[/p][p][/p][h3]Abyss[/h3][list][*][p]\[Swarm Missile] Price 450 → 500[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: We are planning significant adjustments to the Abyss's attack pattern. Before the planned adjustments arrive, we hope to slightly nerf the Abyss's most powerful technology to make it more balanced.[/p][p][/p][h3]Unit Reinforcement Card[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the rank of Rhino, Steel Ball, Mustang, Fire Badger, Fang, and Crawler in unit reinforcement cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Combat Speed[/h2][p]Now the speed-up button will show 20 seconds earlier during combat.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue related to Mountain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple building-related issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple tournament-related issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Some Thoughts on the Future[/h2][p]Looking back, the biggest issue with the patch 1.7 update was insufficient testing. Although we conducted a 3-week Closed Beta Test for the patch 1.7, the number of participants in the Closed Beta Test was too small compared to the hundreds of thousands of players who are active in Mechabellum every month. The small number of test players meant that we were unable to collect statistically significant data, which made it difficult for us to make data-driven adjustments during the testing period. Right now, we are actively revamping our testing process and server architecture. Our goal is to open the test server to all players, which will take quite a bit of time, but we will do it as soon as possible.[/p][p]Regarding unit balance, many players have expressed their desire to utilize fewer chaff units, such as Crawlers and Fangs. We understand this desire, as everyone loves giant robots! However, light units are a very important part of the game's counter loop, so what we can do is add more options for players to counter light units. Several months ago, we began to rework the models, stats, and techs of Fire Badger and Typhoon. And they will become core units that can be freely recruited after the rework, which will significantly increase players' options for countering light units.[/p][p] About the update pace, in the past 12 months, we have probably been adding new content to the game too fast, which has led to us not having enough time to test new content or optimize old content. In the coming months, we will slow down the addition of new systems and focus more on balance adjustments, QOL improvements, and existing content remakes.[/p][p]In terms of collecting feedback, there was many useful feedback in the comment section of the last balance patch, and we have also collected a lot of feedback from Reddit, Discord, and Steam forums, which we are currently studying. Previous feedback has helped our development a lot, and we hope that you will continue to leave more of your opinions and suggestions in the comment section of this article this time.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.7.1
notes.notes:
[p]
As we anticipated, the 1.7.0 Building Layouts have had a significant impact on the overall balance of Mechabellum, and this makes fast balance adjustments necessary. In the past 24 hours, we have received a bunch of feedback and collected a relatively limited amount of data. After some internal discussion, we have decided to release a balance patch based on current data and feedback. And we are very likely to release multiple balance adjustment patches in the near future.
[/p][h3]Building Layouts[/h3][list][*][p]Adjustments have been made to all building layouts, and the new layouts will encourage asymmetric formation more.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of Defense Walls in all building layouts has been reduced from 2 sets to 1 set.[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The new building layouts will be more friendly to asymmetric formations, encouraging more dynamic gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3]Defense Wall[/h3][list][*][p]HP 2030 → 1112 (-45%)[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The adjusted defensive wall will be more easily breached by low-damage units, which will benefit the previously disadvantaged low-damage opening.[/p][p][/p][h3]Rapid-Fire Cannon[/h3][list][*][p]Range 135 → 130[/p][/*][*][p]Attack target: Air & Ground→ Ground-only[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: The adjusted Rapid-Fire Cannon will be more easily countered by air units. And units such as the Mustang with \[Range Enhancement] can also fight better against it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Initial Units[/h3][list][*][p]Removed the starting scenario related to Stormcaller.[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: Players in lower MMR ranges have been disliking the Stormcaller opening for a long time, and we have been constantly looking for a suitable opportunity to address it. After the addition of building layouts in 1.7.0, players' dislike towards Stormcaller opening became even stronger, and players in higher MMR ranges have also begun to dislike it. This has given us a good opportunity to finally resolve this issue, and we can finally remove the Stormcaller opening. It is worth noting that after the addition of Hound, Tarantula, Sabertooth, and Void Eye, the number of units opening increased from the initial 12 to 25. Therefore, we believe that removing 4 Stormcaller openings will not have a significant impact on the opening diversity.[/p][p][/p][h3]Unit Reinforcement[/h3][list][*][p]Significantly reduced the number of units provided by each reinforcement card.[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: After the building layouts were added to the game, the snowball effect in the early rounds has been effectively curbed, which also allows us to rely less on the unit reinforcement cards, which have a similar function. The goal of this adjustment to unit reinforcements is to reduce the number of units on the battlefield in earlier rounds.[/p][p][/p][h3]More feedback[/h3][p]Currently, we are internally discussing the possibility of conducting larger-scale public testing for future patches. We are likely to adjust the testing process and scope in the coming months. Before that, we would like to ask you to leave feedback under this post if you want. More detailed feedback will help us make better adjustments in the future.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/0139c17022df8e23a8485b84d7206b18a2cc01cd.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, commanders![/p][p]Update 1.7.0 is finally here. This update will be carried out at 08:30 AM on August 28, 2025, UTC time. At that time, the server will undergo update maintenance for approximately 4 hours.[/p][p]Now let me introduce the main content of this update to you:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Building Layouts[/h1][p]The building layout consists of a series of buildings on the map. In version 1.7.0, there are 8 different building layouts, and currently, all building layouts are composed of the following 3 types of buildings:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/4de1892854351616abfd5a3cf75223212f4e3504.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Defense Wall: Defensive walls that block enemy fire. They retract into the ground when friendly units approach, allowing them to pass through.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/48468d80e36219cf8bed386f62f5dc0c17bbf31e.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Anti-Armor Cannon: A slow-firing cannon that's effective against heavy units. It takes 10 seconds to reload after every 6 shots.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/6cbaf91b443198823c538c220efa28b4544f1cff.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Rapid-Fire Cannon: A fast-firing cannon that's effective against light units. It takes 2.5 seconds to reload after every 6 shots.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What is unique about buildings compared to units and devices?[/h3][list][*][p]Currently, the building layout only appears in 1v1 and 2v2 battles.[/p][/*][*][p]At the start of each game, the system selects 1 from 8 building layouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings appear on the battlefield in round 1.[/p][/*][*][p]The building layouts of the two opponents are always mirroring or flipping each other.[/p][/*][*][p]All destroyed buildings will be rebuilt at the start of a new round.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings cannot be upgraded or moved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Why is the building layout designed this way, and what are the design goals of the building layout?[/h3][p]At the design phase of the building layouts, we had three different levels of goals:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Goal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Add more information to the round 1 board, reduce the randomness of round 1, and make round 1 gameplay more strategic.[/p][/*][/list][p](Note: In the past, the positions of all units of a player were completely hidden from the opponent in round 1, which led to insufficient information available for strategic decisions to be made. As a result, the deployment phase of round 1 is more or less like a game of rock-paper-scissors, with too much randomness and too little strategy. The main objective of introducing building layouts is to add more information to the battlefield in the first round, enabling players to determine their unit selection and position based on the building layout, thereby reducing the rock-paper-scissors nature of the first round.)[/p][p][b]Secondary Goal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Encourage less formulaic and more emergent strategies by having a different building layout for every game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optional Goals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduce the snowball effect in the early rounds of a game.[/p][/*][*][p]After adding more info to the round 1 board, we may now take the opportunity to remove some special rules introduced to counter the random nature of round 1.[/p][/*][/list][p](Note: In the past, to battle the random nature of round 1, we reduced the deployable area of round 1 by 20m. After introducing the building layout, we can now remove this special rule.)[/p][list][*][p]Utilize the building layout as a new balance tool for starting units.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the impact of buildings on later rounds to ensure that the final outcome of a match is still determined by units.[/p][/*][/list][p]As you can see, the building layouts are mainly designed to address issues from earlier rounds, and we try not to change the game too much while doing so.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Why not design more powerful buildings, and why can't buildings be upgraded?[/h3][p]Mechabellum's battle is automated, where powerful defensive structures will encourage both players to build a large number of static defenses in their own half of the battlefield, thus easily leading to the awkward situation where both players wait for the other to attack.[/p][p][/p][h3]Will there be more building types in the future?[/h3][p]In the future, we will gradually add more building types through updates. These future new buildings will not be overly powerful, but each will have its own unique and interesting aspect.[/p][p][/p][h3]How does the addition of building layouts affect the balance of offensive and defensive strategies?[/h3][p]With the introduction of building layouts, some of the more formulaic strategies will be forced to adapt. According to the test server matches, if properly utilized, these buildings can provide some interesting new opportunities for both offensive and defensive tactics. Both offensive and defensive strategies are pretty viable on the test server.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1][p]The following balance adjustments mainly target units that are significantly affected by Building Layouts.[/p][p]Titan Units[/p][list][*][p]Upkeeps 150 → 0[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock cost 200 → 350[/p][/*][*][p]Removed \[Efficient Maintenance][/p][/*][*][p]The cost of all Techs increased by 200[/p][/*][*][p]HP reduced by 10%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: While the initial purpose of introducing the upkeep concept was to make the Titan one-round kill strategy more viable, we now believe that the Titan one-round kill strategy is too strong at higher MMR ranges, which leads to increased randomness in later rounds. Therefore, we've decided to remove the upkeep concept. This change will significantly weaken the Titan one-round kill strategy, while other Titan strategies will be largely unaffected. In addition, the removal of \[Efficient Maintenance] will provide an additional tech slot for most Titan strategies.[/p][p]Abyss[/p][list][*][p]HP 74395 → 66955 (-10%)[/p][/*][*][p]Upkeep 150 → notes.title: Building Layout Preview
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, commanders![/p][p]Over the past few weeks, we have been testing the 1.7.0 patch on the test server. Since the number of BUGs found during the test is more than we expected, we have decided to reschedule the release date of Update 1.7.0 from the originally planned August 21st to August 28th, so that we have enough time to ensure a stable launch of 1.7.0.[/p][p]Players on the test server have also raised many questions regarding the building layout. So I would like to take today's preview post as an opportunity to answer these questions. Today's preview is like a short essay explaining our design goals, and you can be the professor if you want.^_^[/p][p][/p][h3]What is the building layout?[/h3][p]The building layout consists of a series of buildings on the map. In version 1.7.0, there are 8 different building layouts, and currently, all building layouts are composed of the following 3 types of buildings:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/fedd8099b9a68c4718f1dc4fee34ddd8ed71e39f.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Defense Wall: Defensive walls that block enemy fire. They retract into the ground when friendly units approach, allowing them to pass through.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/4c1d67245cee943735cde4c3979cdacdac83ddf6.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Anti-Armor Cannon: A slow-firing cannon that's effective against heavy units. It takes 10 seconds to reload after every 6 shots.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/cb673d46706bf86859475e75a622a009ec3d5e71.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Rapid-Fire Cannon: A fast-firing cannon that's effective against light units. It takes 2.5 seconds to reload after every 6 shots.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What is unique about buildings compared to units and devices?[/h3][list][*][p]Currently, the building layout only appears in 1v1 and 2v2 battles.[/p][/*][*][p]At the start of each game, the system selects 1 from 8 building layouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings appear on the battlefield in round 1.[/p][/*][*][p]The building layouts of the two opponents are always mirroring or flipping each other.[/p][/*][*][p]All destroyed buildings will be rebuilt at the start of a new round.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings cannot be upgraded or moved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Why is the building layout designed this way, and what are the design goals of the building layout?[/h3][p][/p][p]At the design phase of the building layouts, we had three different levels of goals:[/p][p][b]Main Goal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Add more information to the round 1 board, reduce the randomness of round 1, and make round 1 gameplay more strategic.[/p][/*][/list][p](Note: In the past, the positions of all units of a player were completely hidden from the opponent in round 1, which led to insufficient information available for strategic decisions to be made. As a result, the deployment phase of round 1 is more or less like a game of rock-paper-scissors, with too much randomness and too little strategy. The main objective of introducing building layouts is to add more information to the battlefield in the first round, enabling players to determine their unit selection and position based on the building layout, thereby reducing the rock-paper-scissors nature of the first round.)[/p][p][b]Secondary Goal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Encourage less formulaic and more emergent strategies by having a different building layout for every game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optional Goals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduce the snowball effect in the early rounds of a game.[/p][/*][*][p]After adding more info to the round 1 board, we may now take the opportunity to remove some special rules introduced to counter the random nature of round 1.[/p][/*][/list][p](Note: In the past, to battle the random nature of round 1, we reduced the deployable area of round 1 by 20m. After introducing the building layout, we can now remove this special rule.)[/p][list][*][p]Utilize the building layout as a new balance tool for starting units.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the impact of buildings on later rounds to ensure that the final outcome of a match is still determined by units.[/p][/*][/list][p]As you can see, the building layouts are mainly designed to address issues from earlier rounds, and we try not to change the game too much while doing so.[/p][p][/p][h3]Why not design more powerful buildings, and why can't buildings be upgraded?[/h3][p]Mechabellum's battle is automated, where powerful defensive structures will encourage both players to build a large number of static defenses in their own half of the battlefield, thus easily leading to the awkward situation where both players wait for the other to attack.[/p][p][/p][h3]Will there be more building types in the future?[/h3][p]In the future, we will gradually add more building types through updates. These future new buildings will not be overly powerful, but each will have its own unique and interesting aspect.[/p][p][/p][h3]How does the addition of building layouts affect the balance of offensive and defensive strategies?[/h3][p]With the introduction of building layouts, some of the more formulaic strategies will be forced to adapt. According to the test server matches, if properly utilized, these buildings can provide some interesting new opportunities for both offensive and defensive tactics. Both offensive and defensive strategies are pretty viable on the test server.[/p][p][/p][h3]What will be continuously tested and adjusted in the next 7 days?[/h3][p]We have been making experimental changes on the test server over the past few weeks. The following are things that we are still experimenting with:[/p][list][*][p]We are currently testing different selling prices for buildings. The goal is to ensure that players can sell buildings they don't like while not significantly accelerating the game's economic pace. We will decide on this within the next few days.[/p][/*][*][p]We are currently testing the impact of removing Sticky Oil Bombs from the Research Center. And we will make a decision on whether to remove it within the next few days.[/p][/*][*][p]We are testing the impact of the building layouts on units such as Fang, Crawler, Steel Ball, Stormcaller, Mustang, Sledgehammer, Fortress, and Sandworm, and we will finish adjustments to these units within the next few days.[/p][/*][/list][p]The above is all the information I can share about the Building Layout System for now. The actual 1.7.0 patch includes content beyond the building layouts, which we will share in detail in the patch notes to be released next week.

See you on the battlefield, commenders![/p]

Therefore, we have decided to, while retaining its cost reduction, revert the Attack Interval Modifier change of the [Burst Mode] to +200%, to make it less efficient against smaller units.[/p][p]War Factory[/p][list][*][p]ATK 8355 → 7520(-10%)[/p][/*][*][p][High Explosive Ammo] ATK -30% → -40%[/p][/*][/list][p]Developer's Note: After the upkeep reduction, the usage rate of the War Factory has significantly increased and is now approaching the level of the Fortress, which is too high for a Titan unit.[/p][p]Specialist[/p][list][*][p][Typhoon Specialist] Player HP Modifier 0 → -100[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where Abyss's [Wreckage Recycling] would increase the damage of [Swarm Missiles].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.1
notes.notes: [p][b]Engine upgrade[/b][/p][p]Given that Mechabellum has entered a more stable phase, we now have time to carry out some more rudimentary work. We have decided to perform a minor upgrade to the game engine in this patch. This minor upgrade will not result in any visually noticeable changes in the game, more visible performance and QoL improvements will come in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][p]Mountain[/p][p]• [Saturation Bombardment] Range 40 → 20, Attack Interval Modifier +300% → +200%[/p][p]• [Smoke Bomb] Price 200 → 150[/p][p]• [Anti-Aircraft Ammunition] ATK Modifier -50% → -40%, Price 150 → 100[/p][p]Developer's Note: Currently, Mountain's win rate is relatively low. We hope to improve Mountain's performance by buffing its niche Techs.[/p][p] [/p][p]Farseer[/p][p]• New Tech [Aerial Specialization]: Increases ATK against aerial units by 75% and increases range by 30 when attacking aerial units.[/p][p]• [Full Missile Launch] Attack Interval +250% → +200%[/p][p]Developer's Note: Currently, the game lacks high-HP, all around anti-air units on the ground, and we hope that the Farseer with [Anti-Air Specialization] can fill this role.[/p][p] [/p][p]Wraith[/p][p]• HP 15001 → 14551 (-3%)[/p][p]• ATK 405 → 392 (-3%)[/p][p] [/p][p]Abyss[/p][p]• HP 78310 → 74395 (-5%)[/p][p]Developer's Note: After several buffs, Abyss is currently a bit too strong. Reducing its HP will enable anti-air units to counter Abyss more effectively. Additionally, the newly added Farseer with [Anti-Air Specialization] can also be a good option for countering Abyss.[/p][p] [/p][p]Specialist[/p][p]• [Amplify Specialist] Small Amplifying Core's HP and ATK modifier +20% → +22%[/p][p]• [Supply Specialist] Player HP modifier -500 → -600[/p][p] [/p][p]Starting unit pack[/p][p]• [Crawler & Stormcaller Pack] Player HP modifier -500 → -300[/p][p]• [Hound & Storm Pack] Player HP modifier +200 → +300[/p][p]• [Marksman & Tarantuala Pack] Player HP modifier +300 → +400[/p][p]• [Arclight & Sledgehammer Pack] Player HP modifier +200 → 0[/p][p]• [Arclight & Steel Ball Pack] Player HP point modifier +100 → 0[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][p]• Fixed the issue where Techs sometimes fail to be loaded on units located in the flank area after teleportation.[/p][p]• Fixed the issue where undoing [Intensive Training] operation did not correctly undo unit EXP.[/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/335e0f8a1b318883062cd5b122ebafd689027b92.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, commanders![/p][p]Update 1.6.0 is the first of the two major updates of Season 4. notes.title: Season 4 Preview
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/1096a80f51a251a892022cbe84d67acdc473aeba.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Commanders![/p][p]The fourth season of Mechabellum is coming on July 3rd. Today, we hope to give you a preview of all the content coming to Mechabellum during season 4. The fourth season starts on July 3rd and ends on October 2nd. Currently, Mechabellum has more than 30 different units. In the new Season 4, we hope to add something other than units. The season includes two major updates, Update 1.6 and Update 1.7. Here is a brief look at these 2 updates:[/p][p][/p][h1]Update 1.6 (Arrives on July 3rd)[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Seasonal Rewards[/h2][p]In Season 4, we have prepared many new rewards for you, including many avatars, avatar frames, emoticons, and unit skins. You will learn more about them in the detailed 1.6 patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/6f77c640cc663e1cc6dc39de73f9bfcec668cefa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Music[/h2][p]The new music originally planned to be released in Season 3 finally arrived in Season 4. In Season 4, the system will play different music tracks for you based on the current round and the HP of both players.[/p][p][/p][h2]Mountain and Farseer Became Core Units[/h2][p]The Titan-class unit Mountain and the support vehicle Farseer, which were previously only available through reinforcement cards, can now be unlocked at any time in all modes. We have also added new Techs for these two units.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/8b31de67f7b8a8693792125ee33317cd35187075.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/bff7eb55e9c7ee879f85c894375db5ae844c9cf3.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Major Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2][p]Season 4 is our first season without any new units, which gives us the opportunity to do some major balance adjustments. We will continue to make major balance adjustments throughout Season 4. You will learn more in the detailed patch notes of future updates.[/p][p][/p][h1]Version 1.7 Update (Arrives on August 31st)[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Battlefield Elements - Buildings[/h2][p]Unlike buildings in traditional RTS games, buildings in Mechabellum are more like terrain features. We have made various types of buildings, including cannons, walls, etc. Players will not be able to directly position these buildings. The buildings will be placed on the map in advance by the system. The new building system will add a new strategic dimension to the game, while also giving players more basis for the first few rounds of deployment.[/p][p][b]Note: Since the building system will have a major impact on game balance, it is difficult for us to accurately estimate development time for such a system. There is a possibility that the release of the building system could be delayed.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/afa4fbc39653017277e3ff6c0fb4a377d82acbb5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Wrapping Up[/h1][p]That's all for the preview of the major updates of Season 4. And more details will be listed in the subsequent patch notes. Commanders, see you on the battlefield of Season 4 of Mechabellum![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.5.0 Void Eye
notes.notes:
Commanders, Void Eye and the long-awaited Undo button are here! Update 1.5.0 will be carried out at 1:00 PM on May 22 UTC Time, and the server will be updated and maintained for about 1 hour.

[h1]New Unit: Void Eye[/h1]
As a light ground unit, Void Eye can effectively strike heavy units at medium range, and has unique Techs such as [Aerial Mode], [Electromagnetic Armor], and [Suppression Shots].

Let's take a look at the Void Eye Preview Video produced by MAG1, edited by Stoney, and voiced by RoosterPB.

[previewyoutube=aH-CqhfdZIk;full][/previewyoutube]
Developer's note: With the addition of Void Eye, the number of units in 1v1 and 2v2 modes has reached 30, while the number of units in 4-Player Brawl and Survival Modes has reached 32. The current unit roster has met our core balance needs. In the coming seasons, we will stop adding new units for a while and instead focus on optimizing existing units and systems, and we will try to add new strategic elements such as defense buildings to the game.


[h1]Undo button[/h1]
Now, players can use the Undo button in all game modes.


[h1]Chat[/h1]
Now players can send private chat messages to each other.


[h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1]
Phantom Ray
[list]
[*] [High-Explosive Ammo] Price 200 → 100
[/list]
Sabertooth
[list]
[*] HP 14801 → 15541 (+ 5%)
[/list]
Developer's note: The addition of Void Eye introduced a new counter for Sabertooth. This small buff aims to keep Sabertooth competitive in the early rounds.

Mountain
[list]
[*] Mountain's four main guns are now more inclined to lock onto different targets.
[*] ATK 5086 → 5618 (+ 10%)
[/list]
Developer's note: We are gradually adjusting the strength of Mountain so that it can eventually appear in 1v1 and 2v2 modes in the future.

Reinforcement Cards
[list]
[*] The cost of high-level Melting Points cards has been increased.
[/list]
Developer's note: The price of high-level Melting Points in unit reinforcement is too cheap. This change will make its price close to that of high-level Fortresses.

Ignite
[list]
[*] Units will not be able to restore HP while ignited.
[/list]
Developer's note: This adjustment aims to provide players with more means to combat healing Tech and Item.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where Abyss could accidentally damage allied shields.
[*] Fixed the issue where the shield could not block Phantom Ray's oil bomb.
[/list]

notes.title: Our New Game "Out of Hands" Just launched
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/e2de8d899fa180dacd3d9eaf8240021a3b03709b.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839810/Out_Of_Hands/
Hello everyone! The second game from Game River Studio, "Out of Hands", has just launched!

"Out of Hands" has come a long way. The earliest version of the game was developed by our colleague Yang Zeyu alone during a Game Jam at the end of 2021. He created Out of Hands in his spare time. Because of the time constraint of the Game Jam, Yang Zeyu used his camera to take photos to create the game. To his surprise, the game won multiple awards, and we received a lot of positive feedback from players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/c8f04141bacdb49f3135c6f0b9dba74b3703edbd.png[/img]
Encouraged by enthusiastic players, in 2022, we decided to expand this little demo into a complete game. Out of Hands was still mainly developed by Yang Zeyu, while other colleagues joined to provide assistance, including Chen Dingming, who later wrote most of the final game's code. This is an unconventional two-person team, with Yang Zeyu being the first member and Chen Dingming combined with others to be the second, which is somewhat fitting to the theme of "Out of Hands".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/dd68a389860b1ad747c651d1362722512e40ccae.png[/img]
Time flies, and it's now three years later, 2025. After many delays, "Out of Hands" is finally here! The complete "Out of Hands" became a card adventure RPG. The protagonist of the game wakes up to find that his whole body is composed of many different hands. "Out of Hands" uses card game mechanics, stop-motion videos, IRL photos, and pencil-drawn maps to tell the bizarre adventure of a person who is trapped in their own mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/07e0287a79032a179a136c5ba5f012581ff913f6.jpg[/img]
The development process of "Out of Hand" was a wonderful journey full of surprises for us. And today, we hope that everyone else can experience a different but equally wonderful journey in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/6d2ff2f17b0391aecdd5a21ba5ebcbc682cf2d0f.png[/img]
Thank you all for your help along the way! We hope you enjoy our game!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839810/Out_Of_Hands/

Update 1.4.0 is the first of two major updates of Season 3. This update will be carried out at 07:00 AM on April 3, 2025, UTC time. At that time, the server will undergo update maintenance for approximately 5 hours.

Now let me introduce the main content of this update to you:

[h1]New Unit: Abyss[/h1]
Abyss is a new Titan-class aerial unit, one of the most powerful units on the battlefield, capable of dealing devastating blows to ground units in a large area, and has multiple terrifying Techs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/f7bb8a1ccd08c7a2ecf5fe42ceed9db57989d02e.png[/img]

Let's take a look at the Abyss Preview Video produced by MAG1, edited by Stoney, and voiced by RoosterPB.
[previewyoutube=09H_kOMElCg;full][/previewyoutube]
Developer's note: Adding a new Titan Unit to the game is always scary. We do not yet know how the powerful Abyss will impact the balance of Mechabellum, and we are likely to adjust this unit in the coming weeks.


[h1]New Survival/Brawl Mode Unit: Mountain[/h1]
Mountain is a new Titan-class unit that can be found in the Unit Reinforcement pool of Survival Mode and 4-Player Brawl Mode. Mountain's strong armor can block most attacks on the battlefield, and its multiple giant cannons can deal heavy blows to enemies from a great distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/8b31de67f7b8a8693792125ee33317cd35187075.png[/img]

[*] Saturation Bombardment: Increases range by 40, splash range by 3, and each attack fires 16 shells in succession, and shells spread out over a wide area, but increases attack interval by 300%.
[*] Extended Range Ammo: Increases range by 160, but decreases ATK by 75%.
[*] Photon Loop: Every 30s, covers the unit with a photon coating, decreasing damage received by 30% within 15s and grants immunity to Electromagnetic, Ignited, Acid, and Degeneration Beam effects.
[*] Smoke Bombs: Launches 10 Smoke Bombs towards the enemy every 45s. The Smoke Bombs have a max range of 200m and a minimum range of 100m. The range of units within the smoke is reduced by 35%.

notes.title: Game River Has Partnered With Dreamhaven
notes.notes:
Hello, commanders!

Today I am really happy to announce that Game River Studio has officially partnered with Dreamhaven. Moving forward, the two companies will strive to make Mechabellum even better and introduce Mechabellum to more players.

Many of you may not be very familiar with the name Dreamhaven, but when it comes to its CEO, Mike Morhaime, and his past creations, I think some of you may have a smile from the heart. As cofounder of Blizzard, Mike worked on and led the development of many classic games such as Warcraft, StarCraft, and World of Warcraft. And developers of Game River, like many of you, have very fond memories of these games. Back then, when we were younger, we never thought that one day we would work with the legendary developer who created our favorite games, let alone imagine that he would become a loyal fan of the game we created!

In addition to Mike, Dreamhaven has many other experienced game experts. In the future, Dreamhaven will help us improve the development plan, quality assurance, localization, and community management of Mechabellum. We will also work with community tournament organizers to promote Mechabellum’s already booming esports scene.

Game River and Dreamhaven both believe that Mechabellum has a very bright future, which is why we are focusing more and more resources on Mechabellum. On the battlefield of Mechabellum, we are very grateful to have teammates like Dreamhaven and Mike! And we are even more grateful for the support from our player base. Commanders, let's meet on the battlefield of the upcoming Season 3!

Sincerely
-Youge and the Mechabellum development team


——

Greetings, Mechabellum community,

It’s truly an honor to partner with Youge and the Mechabellum team on this amazing game. I have been so impressed with the design choices and attention to detail they have put into Mechabellum. Game River has created something very special, and many of us at Dreamhaven are dedicated players (myself included).


In addition to creating a cool setting with awesome mech designs and exciting gameplay, Mechabellum captures the things I love about real-time strategy games, without the high APM requirement! I know there are many players of classic RTS games here who feel the same. To me, it’s an added bonus to be able to support a game and a community that really appreciates well-designed competitive play, with a lot of personality and endless strategic depth. 

Another reason we wanted to work with Game River is that we’ve seen how committed they are to continuing to support this game and the community. There’s a lot to look forward to, starting with the upcoming season—as a player and now a partner, I’m eager to see Mechabellum continue to grow and get the attention it truly deserves.

Community is everything, especially for a competitive multiplayer game like this, so thank you for your passion, for spreading the word about this game, and for breathing so much life into the online experience. 

I’m very excited about the future of Mechabellum, and I am so happy Dreamhaven can be part of it. Thank you for your support, and I look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

-Mike Morhaime

notes.title: Update 1.3.1.2 Community Rating
notes.notes:
[h1]Community Rating[/h1]
In the past few years, we have received many requests to update and improve the chat moderation tooling. 

Today, we are officially launching the Community Rating system to help player communities customize what they see in chat and filter chat messages to their own liking.

The rules of the Community Rating system are as follows:
[list]
[*]Each player's initial Community Rating is 1000.
[*]When other players report your messages, your Community Rating will be reduced.
[*]If your Community Rating falls below 600 points, other players will not see your messages in both global and match chats, unless they have specifically enabled the setting that allows them to do so (more below). Playing the game will slowly increase your Community Rating over time. If your Community Rating rises above 600 points, your messages will be visible to all again.
[/list]

The community rating system is not mandatory. 

You can choose to enable “Show messages from players with low Community Ratings” in your individual Settings menu. If you do, you will be able to see everyone’s chat messages, regardless of their Community Rating.

It is worth noting that the Community Rating system is only a tool to help players filter the content they want to see. It is not a judgment of your behavior, or anyone else’s. Over the first few weeks of this new system, we expect players to be curious and play around with this, but we want to both highly discourage abusing the system, as well as emphasize that a lower Community Rating does not indicate bad behavior or character.

We are in the middle of setting up infrastructures to better support the Community Rating system, and we will make an announcement on our Discord server (discord.gg/mechabellum) when that is ready. In the meantime, please ensure that when you are making a report against a player, you are doing so for the right reasons – and not just because you don’t want to see their messages in particular, for that you can just use the block function. 

If you have any questions, concerns, or would like to share your feedback, please join the Discord server (discord.gg/mechabellum), where many of our Commanders are stationed and ready to help!


[h1]Other[/h1]
Optimized the performance of ground fire effects.
Fixed multiple display issues.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.notes:
After multiple rounds of balance adjustments, Mechabellum reached a good balance state at the end of Season 2, with a good proportion of all kinds of strategies. Before the new units in Season 3 inevitably disrupt the balance again, we hope to make one more balance patch. This patch aims to enhance relatively unpopular units and technologies further, and slightly nerf some overly simple tactics.


[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
Sabretooth
[list]
[*]ATK 7372→7962 (+8%)
[*][Missile Interceptor] Interception efficiency +12%
[*][Secondary Armament] Cost 250→200
Dev Note: Sabretooth is currently the weakest among all starting units; this buff aims to improve its viability.
[/list]

Overlord
[list]
[*]Missile HP +10%
[*][Mothership] Cost 300→250
Dev Note: After the cost increased to 500, Overlord became overly vulnerable to missile interception. This adjustment aims to mitigate the issue.
[/list]

Phantom Ray
[list]
[*][High-Explosive Ammo] cost 300→200
[*][Sticky Oil Bomb] Oil radius 30→40
Dev Note: We hope to make the Phantom Ray more versatile by buffing its less popular Tech.
[/list]

Fortress
[list]
[*][Fang Production] Units per batch 10→8, Production interval 32s→36s
Dev Note: After the change, [Fang Production] aligns with Melting Point’s [Crawler Production] in efficiency.
[/list]

Scorpion
[list]
[*]Removed from Round 2 Unit Reinforcement pool
Dev Note: Multiple Scorpion in Round 2 lacked effective counters; this change removes this situation.
[/list]

Mustang
[list]
[*]Rank 3 Mustang removed from Round 3 Unit Reinforcement pool
[*][Missile Interceptor] Interception efficiency -5%
Dev Note: After multiple buffs, Mustang's [Missile Interceptor] became too strong. This change reduces Mustang’s suppression of Storm and Overlord.
[/list]

Wraith
[list]
[*]EXP required for rank-up 1950→2250
Dev Note: High-ranked Wraith is too strong in high MMR matches, we want to slow down their rank-up speed a little.
[/list]

Vulcan
[list]
[*][Perfect Partner] Cost 200→250
Dev Note: We hope to slightly nerf the popular Vulcan Marksman combo by increasing the cost of [Best Partner].
[/list]

Marksman
[list]
[*][Shooting Squad] Summoned Fangs 5→4
Dev Note: A minor nerf to this high-win-rate tech while preserving its core functionality.
[/list]

Farseer
[list]
[*]ATK 1148→1114 (-3%)
[*]Rank 2 Farseer removed from the Unit Reinforcement pool of rounds 1-5
Dev Note: Farseer has a pretty high win rate in all MMR ranges, and Rank 2 Farseer is too strong in early rounds.
[/list]

Specialist
[list]
[*]Aerial Specialist's player HP bonus +300→+400
[*]Amplify Specialist's player HP bonus +100→+200
[*]Training Specialisrt's player HP bonus +0→+100
[*]Cost Control Specialist's player HP bonus +200→+100
[/list]

Initial Units
[list]
[*]Sabretooth Fang opening's player HP bonus +100→+200
[*]Stormcaller Hound opening's player HP bonus +300→+200
[/list]

[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*]It is now easier to delete expired replays.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed multiple data error issues.
[*]Fixed multiple display issues.

[h2]4-Player Brawl[/h2]
[list]
[*]Players who achieve 1st place in 4-Player Brawl will receive a minimum of 8 MMR and 600 Combat Power, regardless of other players' MMR.
[*]Players who achieve 2nd place in 4-Player Brawl will receive a minimum of 4 MMR and 600 Combat Power, regardless of other players' MMR.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
Patch 1.3 introduced changes that significantly impacted game balance. After analyzing data from Patch 1.3, we decided to make the following adjustments:
[h3]Hound[/h3]
[list]
[*]HP increased from 846 to 897 (+6%).
[/list]
Developer’s Note: Hounds currently have a slightly lower win rate compared to other units. This minor HP boost aims to improve their survivability.
[list]
[*][Incendiary Bomb] cost decreased from 300 to 200, and now will lock onto the target.
[/list]
Developer’s Note: Hounds currently are underutilized in non-agro formation. This buff to [Incendiary Bomb] aims to increase their viability in non-agro scenarios.

[h3]Arclight[/h3]
[list]
[*][Charged Shot] cost increased from 150 to 250.
[*][Electromagnetic Shot] cost increased from 200 to 300.
[*]HP increased from 4414 to 4635 (+5%).
[/list]
Developer’s Note: The addition of the Hounds expanded the anti-swarm roster, allowing us to adjust Arclight's role a little bit. After the change, Arclight remains one of the best anti-swarm choices, but it will be less cost-efficient in other roles.

[h3]Tarantula[/h3]
[list]
[*]EXP required for rank-up increased by 11%.
[*][Armor Enhancement] HP bonus increased from 35% to 40%.
[*][High-Explosive Ammo] cost increased from 200 to 300.
[/list]
Developer’s Note: Tarantula openings are still too strong, and its [High-Explosive Ammo] has one of the highest win rates and pick rates in the game. These changes aim to bring down Tarantual to other units' level.

[h3]Steel Ball[/h3]
[list]
[*]EXP required for rank-up increased by 11%.
[/list]
Developer’s Note: After the introduction of Hounds, the win rate of Steel Ball openings has consistently exceeded other strategies. To address this, we increased the EXP required for Steel Ball rank-up, aiming to bring their win rate down to the average level.

[h3]Sabertooth[/h3]
[list]
[*][Missile Interceptor] interception efficiency increased by 20%.
[/list]

[h3]Raiden[/h3]
[list]
[*][Chain] now prioritizes units within 25 meters of the target. Units beyond 25 meters (up to 60 meters) are only chained if no closer targets exist.
[*]HP increased from 15888 to 17476 (+10%).
[/list]
Developer’s Note: Previously, [Chain] often randomly hit backline units far behind the primary target. This change will make [Chain] less random.

[h3]Initial Units[/h3]
Based on recent win rate and pick rate data, we have adjusted HP bonus for the following openings:
[list]
[*]Stormcaller Hound Opening: HP bonus increased from 0 to 300.
[*]Mustang Hound Opening: HP bonus increased from 0 to 500.
[*]Mustang Crawler Opening: HP bonus increased from 300 to 400.
[*]Sledgehammer Hound Opening: HP bonus increased from 0 to 100.
[*]Sabertooth Fang Opening: HP bonus increased from 0 to 100.
[*]Mustang Marksman Opening removed.
[/list]

[h3]Specialists[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.3 New Tournament Mode: 2v2 Tournament
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders, Update 1.3 is finally here! This update introduces a new unit and a new Tournament type, along with significant adjustments to the 4-Player Brawl mechanics. Additionally, we've implemented major balance adjustments. This update will be carried out at 10:30 AM on February 20, 2025, UTC time. At that time, the server will undergo update maintenance for approximately 4 hours.
[h2]New Unit: Hound[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/37540939/6be2b8335e0fa9fe23b5bc26f936302387160cd0.png[/img]
Hounds are mechanical dogs that move in packs, specializing in fighting other light units at medium range. They can even clear acid and fire on the ground if equipped with the right Tech. 
[list]
Developer's Note: The introduction of Hound marks the first addition of a 100-supply chaff unit in the past seven years of Mechabellum development. Hound is likely to create ripple effects in the game's unit counter dynamics. We will anticipate additional adjustments to Hound over the coming weeks.
[/list]

[h2]New Tournament Mode: 2v2 Tournament[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/37540939/8ef24061fa93dc8b1ccfd0da8da1a04140fef060.png[/img]
The new 2v2 tournament will allow players to team up and compete in tournaments. The 2v2 tournaments are held every Sunday with 16 players per group (8 teams).

[h2]4-Player Brawl Changes[/h2]
Due to the expansion of the development team, we now have enough resources to develop more content for the 4-Player Brawl mode. The following changes are the first step in a series of adjustments for the 4-Player Brawl mode.
[list]
[*]Now in 4-Player Brawl players can choose two reinforcements per round, one for equipment, unit modification, or battlefield powers, and one for unit reinforcements.
[*]Now destroying units belonging to the leading player will earn extra points and supplies.
[*]The Boss units of rounds 3 and 6 will now start off from the center of the map.
[*]Boss units in rounds 7-10 were removed.
[*]Another [Inefficient Recovery] has been added to the Research Center.
[*]The [Redeployment] originally in the R&D Center is now usable by default.
Developer's Note: The goal of these adjustments is to provide players with more means of board transition in later rounds, increase build variety, and at the same time reduce the pressure of leading players created by Boss units while making it easier for other players to catch up.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Unlock cost adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sledgehammer's unlock cost decreased from 50 to 0.
[*]Steel Ball's unlock cost decreased from 50 to 0.
[*]Stormcaller's unlock cost decreased from 50 to 0.
[*]Tarantula's unlock cost decreased from 50 to 0.
[*]Mustang's unlock cost decreased from 50 to 0.
[*]Sabertooth's unlock cost decreased from 50 to 0.
[*]Wraith's unlock cost decreased from 100 to 50.
[*]Scorpion's unlock cost decreased from 100 to 50.
Developer's note: The unlocking cost of all units that can appear at the beginning of the game has been adjusted to 0, which will greatly increase strategy varieties of the early rounds. These changes will likely bring big challenges to the balance of the game. We don't know the exact impact of these changes on the balance yet, but we will likely continue to make balance adjustments in the coming weeks.
[/list]

[h3]Fortress[/h3]
[list]
[*]The production quantity for every batch decreased from 12 to 10, and the production interval increased from 30 seconds to 32 seconds.
Developer's note: Fortress' [Fang Production] was relatively strong in the last patch, so we have slightly nerfed it.
[/list]

[h3]Vulcan[/h3]
[list]
[*]ATK increased from 88 to 90 (2% increase).
Developer's Note: Vulcan has a lower win rate compared to other giants. By increasing Vulcan's ATK, We hope to provide players with more options to fight against light units.
[/list]

[h3]Rhino[/h3]
[list]
[*]ATK increased from 3297 to 3560 (8% increase).
Developer's Note: Unlike most other ground units that cost 200 supplies, Rhino still has an unlock cost of 50 supplies. We hope to slightly improve Rhino's situation through a small ATK increase.
[/list]

[h3]Overlord[/h3]
[list]
[*]The HP of Overlord's missiles has increased by 10%.
Developer's Note: This adjustment will help Overlord to perform better against missile interceptions.
[/list]

[h3]Hacker[/h3]
[list]
[*]The price of [Barrier] has increased from 300 to 400, and the HP of the shield has decreased from 20,000 per level to 16,000 per level.
[/list]

[h3]Wraith[/h3]
[list]
[*]The price of [Degeneration Beam] has dropped from 250 to 200.
[/list]

[h3]Tarantula[/h3]
[list]
[*]The EXP required for rank-up has increased by 23%.
[*]ATK decreased from 550 to 534 (3% decrease).
Developer's note: In the last patch, Tarantula were quite strong, especially those that reached level 2 or above early on, and they even performed pretty well against high-HP enemies. These adjustments aim to slow down Tarantula's rank-up speed while also weakening its performance against high-HP enemies.
[/list]

[h3]Raiden[/h3]
[list]
[*]The price of [Fork] has dropped from 250 to 200.
[/list]

[h3]War Factory[/h3]
[list]
[*]The price of [Armor Enhancement] has been increased from 100 to 200.
[/list]

[h3]Phantom Ray[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Stealth Cloak] now will not dodge bullets fired by enemies before Phantom Ray becomes invisible.
[/list]

[h3]Initial Unit[/h3]
[list]
[*]Steel Ball and Arclight opening's HP bonus decreased from 400 to 100.
[*]Tarantula and Fang opening's HP bonus decreased from 200 to 0.
[/list]

[h3]Variant[/h3]
[list]
[*][Mass-Produced Fortress]'s ATK and HP reduction increased from 30% to 40%.
[*][Improved Tarantula] no longer increases ATK, and now increases movement speed by 3 instead of 5.
[*][Extended Range Phantom Ray] now increases range by 30 instead of 20.
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*][Elite Recruitment] will now increase the rank of all units that can be purchased by 1.
[*]Now matches in the lobby will be ordered by MMR by default.
[/list]

The 1.3 update contains a lot of content and will have a huge impact on the balance. According to our plan, we will release several small patches in the coming weeks to tweak the balance further. Commanders, thank you for the continued support, and we hope that everyone can remain patient during the upcoming adjustments.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello commanders, how's Season 2 of Mechabellum going for you? Today we would like to address the balance of Raiden. The current performance of the new Raiden is strong, but some players are also finding ways to counter it. In the three tournaments over the weekend, Raiden users won the Asian tournament, while non-Raiden users won the European and American tournaments. This balance patch aims to nerf Raiden's efficiency against small and large units while maintaining its dominance against medium-sized units.
[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Raiden[/h3]
[list]
[*]Attack interval increased from 4.2 seconds to 4.6 seconds (DPS decreased by 8.7%).
Developer's note: The decrease in attack speed will make Raiden less efficient against small units, and the decrease in DPS will also reduce Raiden's performance against high HP units.
[*]The price of [Chain] increased from 250 to 300.
[*][Chain] no longer jumps to buildings.
[*][Chain]'s damage after the jump decreased from 30% to 25% (meaning jump damage no longer kills Phoenixes of the same rank).
Developer's note: The adjusted [Chain] can no longer damage buildings, and it is now also a lower threat to targets such as Marksman and Phoenix. This change also helps differentiate [Chain] from [Fork] more.
[*]The price of [Electromagnetic Shot] increased from 200 to 300.
Developer's note: [Electromagnetic Shot] has performed exceptionally well in the past few days, so we have decided to increase its price.
[*]The price of [Ionization] decreased from 200 to 100.
Developer's note: [Ionization] significantly weakens Raiden's performance against medium-sized units, while enhancing its performance against giant units. This Tech was rarely used in the last patch, and we hope to increase its use rate a bit.
[*]The price of the [Fork] decreased from 300 to 250.
[/list]

[h3]Phoenix[/h3]
[list]
[*]The resurrection time of Quantum Reassembly has been adjusted from 15 seconds to 12 seconds.
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Optimized the SFX of Sabertooth.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where Raiden's [Chain] would hit cloaked Phantom Rays.
[/list]

Hello commanders, Update 1.2 is finally here. This update will be carried out at 9:00 AM on January 2, 2025, UTC time. At that time, the server will undergo update maintenance for approximately 360 minutes.

[h2]New Season Rewards[/h2]

We have prepared many new season rewards for you in Season 2, and we have made it faster for you to progress through the rewards tree.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/c391b6ce00ffd47ef5f597f520638dbb3bc0f40c.png[/img]
Just like before, at the beginning of the new season, your Combat Power and Insight will be reset to 1, and your MMR will be reset to 90% of the original. At the same time, the system will issue rewards such as Medals and Credits based on your performance in the previous season. In addition, all Season Points that were not spent in the previous season will be converted into Credits.

[h2]New Unit: Raiden[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/440a0821b0eeadea68ad00ca0a63e908afecff0e.png[/img]
Raiden is a new giant flying unit that emits three lightning bolts to hit three different targets with each attack. It is good at fighting medium-sized units and has multiple unique Techs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/d3b32b391b4102fbdce6d525bb92fbeba4449689.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/00c6eaaff6141dc60d62bcdbab662276a6215e38.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/2acd2e47103bcba3fd44e349db4949d7a19ec37b.png[/img]

Optimized the rendering performance of UI.

Sabertooth

Unit Drops

notes.title: Important News about the future of Mechabellum
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Mechabellum’s publisher Paradox ARC and developer Game River have something important to announce.

[h2]Paradox ARC Statement:[/h2]

It’s now been a few months since Mechabellum’s release, and we’re happy to see thousands of people enjoying the game every day. Now, we want to announce some changes regarding the future of Mechabellum. After a fruitful partnership, and bringing the game to the 1.0 release, the developer Game River, and publisher Paradox ARC, decided to part ways

Going forward, Game River will retain all ownership of Mechabellum, and will continue developing the game. For Paradox ARC, Mechabellum was a truly unique game to publish, that came with an unmatched community of competitive players. With our goal of bringing the game to 1.0 launch fulfilled, we’re excited to see Game River’s next steps with Mechabellum, and wish the team all the best!

For Mechabellum players, we want to say “thank you” for working with us to create one of the world’s best wargames. Be driven in your defeats and gracious in your triumphs!

Paradox ARC signing off!

----------------------------------

[h2]Game River Announcement:[/h2]

Hello commanders,

I'm Wen Youge, the lead developer of Mechabellum—you may also know me as Bearlike.

As you know, we are parting ways with publishing partner Paradox ARC. We appreciate the support they provided in helping us get to 1.0, and now that we’re entering the next chapter of Mechabellum, we look forward to a very bright future filled with more of everything you love about the game.

We are going to expand the Mechabellum team so we’ll have more people working on the game, and that means tons of new content—a lot of which will surprise you. We also have broader promotional plans, which will give us even more opportunities to serve players and expand the community. And there is another exciting announcement coming for Mechabellum next year . . . I will let you all know the details as soon as I'm allowed to.

Meanwhile, I hope you will enjoy all the new content we prepared for you in Mechabellum Season 2, which starts on January 2.

See you on the battlefield,

-Youge and the Mechabellum team

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 No More Combat Power Loss
notes.notes:
Season 2 of Mechabellum is near. To enable more players to obtain more seasonal rewards before the end of Season 1, we have further adjusted the Combat Power system. We also added a new initial specialist and some new unit variants to the game, as well as some balance adjustments.
[h2]Combat Power Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Players outside the top 200 worldwide no longer lose combat power when defeated.
[*]Increased combat power gained when winning for players outside the top 200 worldwide.
[*]Players in the top 200 worldwide can lose up to 600 combat power in a battle.
Developer's Note: With these changes, we hope to enable players with lower Combat Power to increase their Combat Power faster while still keeping the Combat Power leaderboard competitive.
[/list]
[h2]New Specialist[/h2]
[list]
[*]New specialist [Missile Specialist]: Get 2 [Missile Strike] for free on round 2.
Developer's Note: Missile Specialist is the first in a series of new specialists, and we plan to add more specialists who provide Battlefield Powers and Equipment Items in the coming month.
[/list]
[h2]New Variants[/h2]
[list]
[*]New variant [Extended Range Phantom Ray]: increases Phantom Ray's range by 20, but decreases HP by 40%.
[*]New variant [Mass-Produced Sandworm]: Decreases the recruitment cost of Sandworm by 100, but decreases Sandworm's ATK by 30% and HP by 30%.
[/list]
[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Crawler[/h3]
[list]
[*]HP decreased from 292 to 277 (5% decrease).
[*][Loose Formation]'s HP reduction increased from 30% to 40%.
[*]The cost of [Mechanical Rage] decreased from 200 to 150.
[*]The cost of [Impact Drill] decreased from 200 to 150.
[*][Subterranean Blitz]'s damage reduction increased from 50% to 55%
Developer's Note: By reducing the HP of Crawlers, we hope that Fangs and Mustangs will be better against Crawlers in the early game.
[/list]
[h3]Overlord[/h3]
[list]
[*]HP decreased from 16099 to 15294 (5% decrease).
[*][High-Explosive Ammo]'s ATK reduction increased from 30% to 40%.
Developer's Note: In the mid and low MMR ranges, players often feel helpless when facing a large number of high-level Overlords. This adjustment hopes to give cheaper units a better chance against Overlords while also maintaining the basic role of Overlords intact.
[/list]
[h3]Sledgehammer[/h3]
[list]
[*]The EXP required to rank up increased by 25%.
Developer's Note: While not very powerful in lower MMR ranges, some Sledgehammer strategies have above-average win rates in higher MMR ranges above 2000. We hope to nerf these strategies by slowing down Sledgehammer's promotion speed.
[/list]
[h3]Wraith[/h3]
[list]
[*]The cost of [Degeneration Beam] decreased from 300 to 250.
Developer's Note: We hope to increase Wraith's usage rate by making its supporting Tech cheaper.
[/list]
[h3]Scorpion[/h3]
[list]
[*]ATK increased from 10047 to 10650 (6% increase).
[*][Siege Mode]'s range bonus increased from 80 to 100.
[*]Developer's note: We hope to increase Scorpion's usage rate by making it stronger against high HP units.
[/list]
[h3]Phantom Ray[/h3]
[list]
[*]The cost of [Stealth Clock] increased from 200 to 250.
[*]The cost of [Sticky Oil Bomb] decreased from 200 to 100.
[*]The cost of [Burst Mode] decreased from 250 to 200.
Developer's Note: As a new unit, the Phantom Ray has a surprisingly balanced win rate. However, some Phantom Ray Techs do not see enough usage. These changes aim to balance the usage rate for all Phantom Ray Techs.
[/list]
[h3]Equipment[/h3]
[list]
[*][Nano Repair Kit] adjusted from level 2 to level 3.
Developer's Note: While the Nano Repair Kit's win rate isn't particularly impressive, it can be very powerful in certain situations, so we decided to change it from a level 2 card to a level 3 card.
[/list]
[h3]Unit drops[/h3]
[list]
[*]The cost of high-level Sandworm cards has been increased.
Developer's Note: Although the overall win rate of Sandworms is not outstanding, the impact of high-level Sandworm reinforcements on the battlefield is significantly greater than that of other giant units. This change hopes to weaken the impact of high-level Sandworm reinforcements.
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*]Optimized the sound effects of the Phantom Ray.
[*]Fixed and optimized several localized texts based on community feedback.
[/list]

notes.title: Mechabellum 1.0 Out Now!
notes.notes:
The day is finally here! After 16 months in Early Access, Mechabellum 1.0 is fully released!
[previewyoutube=TcJoUc7NaTo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]To all our loyal Early Access players:[/h3]
Thank you for being with us and helping bring Mechabellum to this point. We hope you like your Early Access rewards and look forward to the future, as there is more coming to Mechabellum! Our game couldn't be what it is today without you!

One favor we have to ask of you, is to continue being a welcoming community to the many new players that will join us in the coming days and weeks! Give them some good advice, and help them learn from their wins and loses both!

[h3]To our new players, discovering the game now:[/h3]
Welcome! Stay a while, win some battles, lose some, improve, overcome and help us in continuing to build one of the best competitive gaming communities in the world!

Oh. And hop into our Discord when the mood fancies you, and share any feedback and thoughts you have about Mechabellum!
[url=http://discord.gg/BU4VEt5E69][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/584c31f12d44c9f48c1cf04ed56704b7bf52c57f.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Mechabellum 1.0 features:[/h2]
Mechabellum 1.0 wraps up the Early Access by adding the long-awaited rank system, as well as competitive Seasons to the game, plus a few additional features and changes.
[b]Visual Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] The visuals of the map [Training Base] have been improved.
[*] All specialists now have new avatars
[/list]
[b]New Specialists[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Badger specialist
[*] Typhoon specialist
[/list]
[b]Inappropriate Content Filtering[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can choose different filtering levels: no filtering, filtering, strict filtering
[/list]
[b]Shortcuts[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can press the shortcut U to promote the selected unit.
[*] Players can press the shortcut Ctrl + U to promote all units of the same type.
[/list]
[b]Round Countdown[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the music will stop playing at the last 10 seconds of the round.
[*] The sound of a clock will now be played at the last 10 seconds of the round.
[/list]
[b]Performance Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the game's memory usage.
[/list]
[b]Competitive Seasons[/b]
[list]
[*] A new season will start every 3 months.
[*] Each season will have its own reward tree.
[/list]
[b]Rank System[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting from the first season, players can reach different leagues by improving their combat power.
[/list]
[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We'll now spend the next few days processing any feedback, bug reports and similar, and patching them as they pop up, to make sure all of you have a good time with the game. Be fast with reporting anything we could have missed, and we'll try our best to fix it ASAP!

Also, starting today, keep an eye out on YouTube and Twitch for your favorite content creators. There will be a ton of cool videos popping up here and there, with the aim of bringing new players into our fold. Who knows. Maybe you're one of them. >.>

Here's one from one of our favorite tea-addled YouTubers:
[previewyoutube=gvbOruydZ5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We already mentioned we have plans for Mechabellum post 1.0, and teased a few upcoming units. More information will have to wait a bit, so bear with us in the meantime!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540939/d76b9dd5e7e854ced786457a22b7e1db461b4efe.png[/img]

[h3]Wrapping up[/h3]
Mechabellum is something unique in its genre. We learned that best working with you all during the Early Access. That's why your feedback was essential in making the best Tactical Wargame we could.

Now we only want to ask you to keep sharing your thoughts with us after the 1.0 release as well! There is a lot more we want to do together with you!

For now though, enjoy Mechabellum 1.0! Outthink your opponents, counter their plays, climb the ranks and claim your well-earned trophies!

See you on the battlefield.
